title: My Friends at School
text:
My friend Ana is very kind. She helps everyone in our class. She is also funny, and she makes us laugh every day.

Her brother Leo is shy. He does not talk much in class, but he is very smart. He likes to read books at home.

questions.text: What does Leo like to do at home?
Why do people probably like Ana?
options: She helps others and makes them laugh
She does not talk to anyone

questions.text: What can you infer about Leo in class?
options: He is probably quiet but clever

vocabulary.definition: friendly and helpful to other people
not comfortable talking to other people
able to learn and understand things quickly

paragraph_translations: Minha amiga Ana é muito gentil. Ela ajuda todo mundo na nossa turma. Ela também é engraçada e nos faz rir todos os dias.
O irmão dela, Leo, é tímido. Ele não fala muito na aula, mas é muito inteligente. Ele gosta de ler livros em casa.
